name: Blockyard Purpur
author: operator@blockyard.local
description: Reviewed Minecraft 1.21.1 installer. EULA acceptance is required separately. Loader variables are operator-managed.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server
rm -f .blockyard-install.json
curl --user-agent "Blockyard/0.1 (Minecraft hosting)" --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 600 --fail --location --retry 3 "https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/${BUILD_NUMBER}/download" -o server.jar.part
mv server.jar.part server.jar
jar tf server.jar > /dev/null
printf '{"software":"PURPUR","minecraft_version":"%s","loader_version":"%s"}\n' "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" "${BUILD_NUMBER}" > .blockyard-install.json.tmp
mv .blockyard-install.json.tmp .blockyard-install.json
